fullDescription.from:
This  OOAK Tailor art doll is a tiny handmade character created with polymer clay and carefully selected fabric details. He is portrayed as a traditional tailor, surrounded by the little touches of his craft, giving the miniature a warm, nostalgic and wonderfully whimsical character.

Every detail is sculpted and finished by hand, from his expressive face and clothing to the tiny fabric elements that complete his appearance. The combination of polymer clay and real fabric gives this little figure a particularly tactile and authentic look.

The doll is approximately 10–12 cm  tall. This is a one-of-a-kind handmade art piece, created as a collectible miniature rather than a toy. He would make a lovely addition to a collection of miniature characters, a sewing-themed display, or a unique gift for someone who loves handmade art, tailoring and charming little stories captured in sculpture.

fullDescription.from:
OOAK Old Man with dog – Handmade Art Doll
(approximately 15–16 cm tall / about 6–6.3 inches)

This one-of-a-kind art doll is entirely hand-sculpted from polymer clay and carefully hand-painted with high-quality acrylic paints. Depicting a thoughtful old man accompanied by his faithful rat companion, this unique collectible captures a quiet moment of friendship, trust, and companionship.

Every detail has been crafted by hand, from his expressive face, weathered features, and long gray beard to his handmade clothing and tiny animal friend. The character's contemplative expression and gentle interaction with the rat suggest a story waiting to be told, inviting the viewer to imagine his life, travels, and adventures.

Built on a wire armature, the doll features movable limbs and is dressed in handcrafted clothing tailored specifically for this character. No molds are used in the creation process, making this a true OOAK (One of a Kind) collectible that can never be exactly duplicated.

Perfect for collectors of art dolls, fantasy characters, folk art, and literary-inspired miniatures, this piece brings warmth, personality, and storytelling charm to any display. Whether placed on a bookshelf, in a curio cabinet, or among a collection of unique handmade creations, it is sure to attract attention and spark curiosity.

The doll measures approximately 15–16 cm (6–6.3 inches) in height. It will be carefully packed in protective packaging and shipped with a tracking number. Please handle with care, as this is a delicate collectible art piece intended for display rather than play.

fullDescription.from:
Meet this curious little forest wanderer, dressed in rustic handmade clothes and carrying a large, colorful backpack filled with mysterious treasures. With his tall crooked hat, expressive face, slightly tousled hair, and long pointed shoes, he looks as though he has been traveling through the woods for quite some time — and probably has a story or two to tell.

His oversized backpack is made from textured fabrics and decorated with colorful woven details, making a wonderful contrast to his simple dark clothing. He carries a natural wooden walking stick, giving him the appearance of an old-fashioned traveler who is always ready to continue his journey down another forest path.

The doll is entirely hand-sculpted and hand-painted, with every detail created individually. A wire armature inside allows the arms and legs to be moved slightly for posing. His rustic clothing, tall handmade hat, textured backpack, tiny buttons, pointed shoes, and natural wooden staff all contribute to his unique old-world character.

Approximately10-11 cm tall, he would make a lovely addition to a fantasy or woodland collection, miniature display, diorama, dollhouse scene, or simply a special place on a shelf.

He is a true OOAK (One of a Kind) handmade art doll — there will never be another exactly like him.

fullDescription.from:
OOAK Miniature Granny Baker with a Freshly Baked Pie

She is entirely hand-sculpted from polymer clay and carefully hand-painted, with every tiny feature individually created by hand. Her expressive face has a warm, slightly cheeky character, while her curly gray hair and vivid red bow add a playful touch.

She wears a handmade blue sweater with a delicate white collar, a white textured apron, and a warm mustard-colored skirt finished with a small ruffled edge. Tiny red shoes complete her charming old-fashioned appearance. In her hands she carefully holds a miniature pie, complete with a beautifully sculpted woven crust and intricate surface details.

Standing approximately 10 cm (4 inches) tall, she is a one-of-a-kind miniature art doll created for display and collecting. Built on a wire armature, her arms can be gently posed, adding even more character to the piece.


Its a unique piece of handmade art for collectors of miniature figures, whimsical characters, folk-inspired art, and OOAK dolls. She can be displayed on a shelf, in a cabinet of curiosities, or incorporated into a miniature kitchen or storybook scene.

This is a delicate collectible artwork rather than a toy and should be handled with care.

fullDescription.from:
This little witch is a one-of-a-kind handmade art doll, sculpted in polymer clay and dressed in carefully crafted black fabric. She has an expressive face, a mischievous smile, wild gray hair and a tall, slightly crooked pointed hat that gives her a distinctive storybook character.

She carries a handmade broom made from natural fibers and a rustic branch, which adds to her traditional folklore appearance. Her black dress is finished with delicate details , while a small pendant hangs around her neck.

At approximately 10 cm (about 4 inches) tall, she is a tiny but highly detailed collectible sculpture. Her lively expression and slightly eccentric appearance make her feel like a character who has stepped out of an old fairy tale or folk story.

This witch is created as a collectible art doll and is intended for display rather than play. She would make a charming addition to a collection of fantasy and folklore characters, miniature sculptures, or handmade art dolls.

fullDescription.from:
OOAK Miniature Forest Witch Baba Yaga with Crow in Nest and Broom – Handmade Art Doll (approximately 10 cm / 3.9 inches tall)

This one-of-a-kind handmade art doll is entirely hand-sculpted and hand-painted, standing at approximately 10 cm (3.9 inches) tall. She features an extraordinarily expressive, characterful face with realistic wrinkles, intense eyes, and wild, textured gray hair woven with twigs and a tiny bird's nest perched on top, complete with a miniature black crow. 

Dressed by hand in a rustic, layered woodland ensemble, she wears an olive-green linen tunic, a dark apron, a tattered distressed shawl, and a vintage-style skull key pendant around her neck. She holds a handcrafted rustic wooden broom, perfect for her forest adventures. Built with an internal wire frame, her arms and legs are gently poseable for versatile styling. Every element is individually crafted and finished, ensuring that no two dolls are ever identical.   

This collectible miniature is ideal for OOAK art doll collectors, lovers of Slavic folklore, Baba Yaga enthusiasts, and fans of dark cottagecore or witchy décor. She makes a enchanting centerpiece for dollhouse displays, shadow boxes, curio cabinets, forest dioramas, and fairytale collections. As a delicate handmade art collectible, please handle her gently and keep her away from moisture, heat, and small children. Each order is carefully packed in protective packaging and ships with a tracking number included.
